MMUD_Explorer.usage: read-only cross-check; no repository write or push

ordering: sum equipped item Accuracy (+0x39A); if the sum is zero, use pity value 1
when living and encumbrance <33%, add 15-trunc(encumbrance/10) into the same equipment/encumbrance accuracy bucket
fold that bucket as 2*trunc(bucket/2), preserving native even-value behavior
after fighter construction, add direct plus-accuracy cache user +0x70A
martial Punch/Kick/JumpKick accuracy adjustments are added later by their own native ability paths
native_contract.formula_base: 2*((C-1)*floor(sqrt(L)) + 2*C + trunc(L/2) + trunc(B/2) - 2) + trunc((STR-50)/3) + trunc((AGI-50)/6), where B is pity-adjusted equipped accuracy plus the living <33% encumbrance bonus
native_contract.consumer: _calculate_attack consumes fighter +0x00 as attacker Accuracy in the already-PASS physical hit/Dodge resolver.

runtime_change: Reforged no longer approximates Classic base Accuracy as combatCode*Level plus a generic STR/AGI attack value. RuntimePlayerCombatProfileResolver now builds the native fighter Accuracy base, folds all equipped item accuracy in the native even-value bucket, and keeps direct ability/status plus-accuracy separate. Normal/PvP live combat no longer double-adds wielded weapon accuracy after that equipped-accuracy fold.
megamud_compatibility: MegaMUD continues to consume ordinary server combat results; its imported executable contains Accuracy/Accuracy Bonus statistics labels but no Reforged-private formula transport is required.
borin_compatibility: Borin consumes server-authoritative combat outcomes/state and must not substitute a private class/base Accuracy formula.
